# Caléonis Receptionist — private launch preview

French-first AI receptionist pilot for businesses, based on MIT-licensed LobbyStack.
Reviewed product: /fr/features/
Pilot help and limitations: /fr/resources/
Help centre: /aide/
Pricing: on request. No published plan, quota or payment offer.
French pilot number: Voice-only; SMS unsupported. Human transfer is not advertised as enabled.
Medical use: no established HDS qualification; fictional administrative demonstrations only.
